content: CONFIRMED — `timeline()` decodes every row inside one loop at `SqliteHostStorePersistence.java:249-252`; `decodeMessage()` throws `IllegalStateException` for any corrupt `message_json` at `:502-524`, aborting the whole page. The REST guard maps that exception to `INTERNAL_UNEXPECTED`/HTTP 500 at `LocalHostServer.java:868-870`, while projection replacement does not repair an existing same-length row (`SqliteHostStorePersistence.java:452`), so the failure persists.
